name: Muela de Villaspesa
story: The Muela de Villaspesa was an intermediate fortified point south of Teruel overlooking the Republican positions at Aldehuela and the Turia valley. Its defenders dug a tunnel from the trench line to the back of the hill so they could move without being seen or hit from the Republican positions at Las Cañadas.
see: Trenches and observation posts on the slope facing Aldehuela, and the tunnel, whose rear entrance is now sealed.
plan: It is near Villaspesa, about 8 km south of Teruel. Open hillside, so bring boots. Combine it with the Aldehuela bunker opposite.

boxes.text: TracesOfWar does not say which side held the Muela. The layout suggests the Nationalists, but this is not confirmed.
